The '''Chiss Academy''' was a military training program run by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] that taught students how to analyze and respond to situations. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] studied at the Academy in her youth prior to becoming a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|general]].

==Description==
The Chiss Academy was an educational institution within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], located in Chiss Space in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Academy taught students to thoroughly analyze information to respond effectively and with precision. Along with the values of the ruling [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]], the Academy led to a cultural taboo within [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] society against preemptive strikes to the extent that use of the tactic<ref name="ETU" /> was [[Defensive-only doctrine|legally]]<ref name="DNI">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> punishable by [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="ETU" />

==History==
The young Chiss [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] studied at the Academy prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], which initiated the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> According to a story told among [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] that later served under Tann, a [[Unidentified professor (Chiss Academy)|professor]] challenged her to train a group of [[Yresilini]] into an [[Army/Legends|army]] in spite of the [[Species/Legends|species']] perceived untrainable nature. Tann selected a Yresilini [[Unidentified first Yresilini general|general]] to learn basic commands and [[Death/Legends|executed]] him when he disobeyed. The [[General/Legends|general's]] [[Unidentified second Yresilini general|successor]] led the other Yreslini to follow Tann's orders, and she received high marks for her assignment, going on to become a general for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Academy was first mentioned in Sev'rance Tann's databank entry in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.<ref name="CC" />
